parts.text: A student determines the electromotive force (e.m.f.) and resistance of a cell by using a resistance wire. She uses the circuit shown in Fig. 2.1. Fig. 2.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) On Fig. 2.1, draw a voltmeter connected to measure the potential difference (p.d.) across terminals P and Q. [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The switch is closed. The student moves the crocodile clip on the resistance wire so that the potential difference V across terminals P and Q is 5.0 V.
